gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-wix-madefor-disp: Pixelify Sans draws every stroke at a constant width, like blocks cut from one strip. Wix Madefor Display is the quieter one, with gently flared curve ends that stay apart.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ysabeau: Bold and a little playful, Pixelify Sans cuts its letters from strips of equal width. And Ysabeau follows with sweeping sans curves that never close up, so the text keeps moving smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ysabeau-sc: Pixelify Sans has a marker-like, steady line weight. Make it small and that blunt strength fades, while Ysabeau SC, a sans with a visibly gaping c, holds up better when it runs larger.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zalando-sans-exp: Chunky, blocky, unmistakably digital. Zalando Sans Expanded lets a sparse row of widely spaced letters breathe underneath, so the text moves slowly and the c tips never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zalando-sans-sem: Rope-fine strokes, bent into blocky shapes. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded brings open-mouthed curves on c, e, and s, and that stark gap between the two is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei is the gentle one here, with a soft weight shift from stem to serif and slimmer crossbars. Pixelify Sans is flat and contrast-free, so shrink it and it loses punch.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans reads technical but friendly, with a wide channel into every bowl. And against Pixelify Sans, bent like neon tubing at constant thickness, that difference in line is what makes the pair.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-zilla-slab: Sturdy and technical, Zilla Slab gives every bowl-ended curve a broad opening under Pixelify Sans, whose bars keep identical thickness. The slab-serif body anchors the blocky heading.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-amulya: Revalia stretches out in a tall band, its letters widely separated. Revalia is best at making a statement, while Amulya, a sans-serif with generous gaps in its curves, is best at quietly carrying the text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-arsenal: Arsenal reads close-knit, its x-height nearly touching the cap height. Against Revalia's widely spaced, relaxed stride, that tight texture is the strongest thing about the pair.
